title: Your own beginning makes the return thinkable

phrase.meaning: He is surely able to bring him back

points.label: What research comes close
points.text: Britannica’s Qur’an entry notes that many passages **rehearse the natural order** to show God’s **power to recreate** the dead (e.g. 75:37-40). Ibn Kathir on 36:77-79: the One who made man from **a weak drop** “is not unable to re-create him.”

points.label: One possible reading
points.text: The argument moves from what no hearer can deny to what they doubt. Verse 7’s fluid **“comes out”** from hidden places; verse 9’s **secrets are laid bare**. The God who brought you out of hiding once can **bring out what is hidden again**.

bottom_text: The strongest reply: birth repeats daily, but no one has seen decayed bones live again. The Qur’an records that very objection in 36:78: “Who will revive bones when they have crumbled?”
source_label: Ibn Kathir on 36:77-79 · Britannica, “Quran: Basic ideas”
